guideTitle: How to bridge tokens using the Uniswap web app

steps.action: Open the web app and connect your wallet
steps.expected: Wallet is connected to the Uniswap web app

steps.action: Select the token you want to bridge
steps.expected: Chosen token is shown as the token to bridge

steps.action: Select the network you want to bridge to
Enter the amount you would like to bridge, or select the “Max” option
steps.expected: Amount is filled in; “Max” inputs the total amount of the token available in your wallet
Review of the bridge is shown with an “Approve and swap” option
Wallet prompts to approve Uniswap to access your tokens

steps.action: Using your wallet, approve Uniswap to access your tokens (requires a network cost)
In your wallet, confirm the bridge (requires a network cost)
steps.expected: Bridge completes; received tokens are in your wallet and swap details are viewable in the portfolio activity section

attempts.objective: Do not connect a wallet or sign anything. On the Uniswap app swap page, click the token drop-down for the token you are selling (the top 'Sell' field) to open the token selector. Confirm a token list opens. Select any token from the list (for example 'ETH') as the token to bridge. Confirm that token is now shown in the top field. Then click the token drop-down again to reopen the token and network selection. Never press 'Swap', 'Review', 'Confirm Swap', 'Approve', or 'Connect wallet'. Assert that a token selection list is visible again, showing token names such as the one you chose, along with network options or a network selector.
